title: DG endomorphism model of a perfect generator on a qcqs algebraic space
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]: every open cover of $|X|$ has a finite subcover, and the absolute diagonal is quasi-compact. Use its small etale structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$, module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $C_X=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ for the full subcategory with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Perfect means etale locally represented by a bounded complex of direct summands of finite free structure modules [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. A differential graded algebra over $\mathbf Z$ means an associative unital graded ring $A=\bigoplus_{i\in\mathbf Z}A^i$ with additive differential $d:A^i\to A^{i+1}$ satisfying $d^2=0$ and $d(ab)=d(a)b+(-1)^ia\,d(b)$ for $a\in A^i$. A right differential graded $A$-module is a graded right module $M$ with $d^2=0$ and $d(ma)=d(m)a+(-1)^jm\,d(a)$ for $m\in M^j$. Write $D(A,d)$ for the homotopy category of these modules localized at the maps inducing isomorphisms on all cohomology groups; triangles are the distinguished mapping-cone triangles. Let $G\in C_X$ be perfect and compact [def-pc-compact-object], and suppose that $L\simeq0$ whenever $L\in C_X$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(G[n],L)=0$ for every $n\in\mathbf Z$. There exist such a differential graded algebra $(A,d)$ and an exact equivalence of triangulated categories $F:C_X\xrightarrow{\sim}D(A,d)$, with exact quasi-inverse $T$, for which $F(G)\simeq A$ and, for every $L\in C_X$, there are natural isomorphisms of abelian groups $H^i(F(L))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(G,L[i])$ for all $i\in\mathbf Z$. In particular $H^i(A)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(G,G[i])$. Here exact means additive, commuting with integer shifts by specified natural isomorphisms and carrying distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category].

source.place: Tag 09MC, theorem-DQCoh-is-Ddga and its proof, with an arbitrary chosen perfect generator and its K-injective representative; the displayed derived tensor/Hom adjunction and equation-E-is-OK.

proof.text: Use [def-weil-size-convention] to work on a small representative of the etale site. Choose a cochain representative of $G$. By [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] it has a quasi-isomorphism to a K-injective complex $K$. Thus $K\simeq G$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ and has the same quasi-coherent cohomology. Apply [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom]: $A=\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}(K,K)$ is the required unital dg algebra, and there is a specified exact adjunction $T=-\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}K\dashv R=R\operatorname{Hom}(K,-)$ with $T(A)\simeq G$ and invertible unit $\eta_A$.

source.place: Tag 09MC, first paragraph and equation-E-is-OK (09MD); dga.tex Tags 09LX and 09LY.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-dg-tensor-quasicoherent], $T$ lands in $C_X$. By [lem-sfb-space-perfect-localizing-generation], $C_X$ is a full triangulated subcategory and its coproducts are computed in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. Restrict $R$ to $F:C_X\to D(A,d)$. Fullness restricts the same adjunction bijections to $T\dashv F$, with the same unit. Exactness restricts because the triangles are inherited; preservation of coproducts by $T$ is inherited from [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom].

source.place: Tag 09MC, paragraph restricting tensor to D_QCoh, using Tag 09MA; closure under sums is Tag 08F3.

proof.text: The hypothesis makes $G$ compact in $C_X$, and $T(A)\simeq G$ is compact by transport of the defining Hom bijections across this isomorphism. Therefore [lem-sfb-dg-adjunction-compact-unit] applies to the restricted adjunction from Step 2: $T$ is fully faithful and $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to FT$ is invertible. This uses compactness only in $C_X$, with no inference of ambient compactness.

source.place: Tag 09LZ, lemma-fully-faithful-in-compact-case, proof applied in the actual target C_X.

proof.text: For $L\in C_X$, [lem-sfb-ringed-site-dg-tensor-hom] gives natural isomorphisms $H^i(F(L))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(K,L[i])\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(G,L[i])$, the last using $K\simeq G$ and fullness. If $F(L)\simeq0$, these groups vanish for every $i$. Shifting identifies $\operatorname{Hom}(G[n],L)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}(G,L[-n])$; the assumed detection property gives $L\simeq0$. Thus $F$ has zero kernel.

source.place: Tag 09MC, last paragraph: the kernel of the restricted adjoint is zero; equation-E-is-OK and the derived Hom computation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-exact-adjoint-zero-kernel-equivalence] to $T\dashv F$, using exactness from Step 2, full faithfulness from Step 3 and the zero kernel from Step 4. It gives the desired exact equivalence $F:C_X\simeq D(A,d)$ with exact quasi-inverse $T$. The isomorphism $\eta_A:A\simeq FT(A)$ and $T(A)\simeq G$ give $F(G)\simeq A$. Step 4 supplies the stated natural cohomology identifications; at $L=G$ and after $F(G)\simeq A$ they give $H^i(A)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{C_X}(G,G[i])$.

source.place: Tag 09J1, lemma-fully-faithful-adjoint-kernel-zero, as cited at the end of spaces-perfect.tex Tag 09MC.

The item statement is the same as on the base and is faithful to 09MC for a given compact detecting generator. No SGA source and no repair note. Step 1: K-injective resolution (generic tool prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist, accepted) and the tensor-hom node give A=End^•(K), the exact adjunction, T(A)≅K and η_A invertible. Step 2: 09MA node plus localizing-generation give that C_X is triangulated with ambient coproducts, so the adjunction restricts. Step 3: relative 09LZ criterion with compactness in C_X; this correctly avoids 09MC's unsupported inference of ambient compactness from 09M8. Step 4 (elementary): H^i formula plus shift plus detection give zero kernel. Step 5: zero-kernel criterion 09J1. New nodes: the tensor-hom node's signs, right action, unit and H^i formula check out, and K=0 and point cases hold. The compact-unit criterion is true: RT preserves coproducts, the unit's iso-locus is localizing, and property-(P) resolutions generate. The QCoh-image node is true for any space. None is a duplicate (bundle/tilting/trf bimodule/cbc/coef Yoneda nodes compared) and none restates the item. No cycle. Batch-5: def-trf-algebraic-space and def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module are general definitions already in the item's stmt_deps. lem-sfb-space-perfect-localizing-generation is Bondal–van den Bergh, not a trace-formula or Poincaré step, and the parent already cites it. Accepted.
